## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增由 Karabiner-Elements 驱动的 Windows 键盘模式，将内建键盘的修饰键映射为 Windows 风格的 Ctrl、Win 和 Alt，同时保留终端快捷键。
- 启用 Windows 键盘模式前自动备份有冲突的 Karabiner 映射；停用该模式时可恢复之前的配置。

### 性能

- 复用 Alt-Tab 已缓存的窗口缩略图和操作能力，仅刷新缺失数据与新创建的窗口。

### 修复

- 从 Alt-Tab 中排除 macOS 系统对话框、浮动工具窗口和其他不可切换界面，同时保留标准应用窗口与应用对话框。
- Karabiner 重映射后的实体修饰键仍按住时保持 Alt-Tab 打开，避免在 Windows 键盘模式和 Windows App 会话中切换界面瞬间关闭。

## English

### Added

- Added a Karabiner-Elements-backed Windows keyboard mode that maps the built-in keyboard's modifier keys to Windows-style Ctrl, Win, and Alt roles while preserving Terminal shortcuts.
- Backed up conflicting Karabiner mappings before enabling Windows keyboard mode and restored the previous configuration when the mode is disabled.

### Performance

- Reused cached Alt-Tab thumbnails and window capabilities, refreshing only missing data and newly created windows.

### Fixed

- Excluded macOS system dialogs, floating utility windows, and other non-switchable surfaces from Alt-Tab while retaining standard application windows and dialogs.
- Kept Alt-Tab open while a Karabiner-remapped physical modifier remains held, preventing the switcher from immediately closing in Windows keyboard mode and Windows App sessions.
